summary.intent: Group related pending todos (#5 encrypt share itemName, #8 route shared-folder writes through SDK, #9 remove redundant web folder-seeding) into GSD Phase 48, plan and execute it autonomously while the user is AFK — with the REQ-1 web-e2e regression gate as the critical first step.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 was created, researched, planned (6 plans, checker passed), and Wave 1 (REQ-1) was executed and debugged through four CI dispatches plus local reproduction. The real root cause was identified as a useAuth.ts isLoading race gap causing BinPage to bounce, combined with a loadBin destructive empty-publish bug; both were fixed and verified locally (2 greens under NODE_ENV=test). The session ended just before the final commit/push/CI redispatch.

repo: web-e2e only auto-triggers on push to main (ci-e2e.yml), but web-e2e.yml is directly workflow_dispatch-enabled — `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` runs the identical job against any branch ref pre-merge, resolving repo secrets directly with no parent needed.

bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts uses the real Web3Auth DEVNET Core Kit (loginViaWallet → mock EIP-6963 wallet → SIWE → Core Kit), NOT the test-login bypass — needs VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID and outbound internet; TEST_LOGIN_SECRET/SDK_E2E_SECRET are irrelevant to this spec.

IPNS resolve throttle limits in app.module.ts:56,61 are NODE_ENV-gated: development enforces 30/min (causes 429 storms during step-8 post-restore root-render), test relaxes them — local e2e MUST use NODE_ENV=test to match CI behavior.
migrationsRun:true + synchronize:false in app.module.ts:105 means TypeORM runs migrations automatically on API boot — no manual migration step needed for local e2e.
IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY is optional locally when NODE_ENV!=production; the API generates an ephemeral RS256 keypair. Only required in production.

docker/docker-compose.yml redis maps host port 6380 by default (not 6379 like CI) and POSTGRES_DB defaults to 'cipherbox' (not cipherbox_test) — use docker run with explicit ports/env or override to match CI.

Playwright webServer array auto-starts all three servers (mock-ipns :3001, API :3000, web :5173); only the 3 Docker services need manual startup. reuseExistingServer:!CI means local running servers are reused.
Phase 47 covered owned-folder SDK consolidation (PR #494); Phase 48 is its shared-folder counterpart, plus the #498 self-bootstrap regression and itemName ECIES wrap.
The GSD 'phase' branching strategy creates a new branch (feat/<slug>) off HEAD, inheriting all planning commits — it does not branch from origin/main separately.
PR creation via gh pr create triggers a bot release commit — must fetch+rebase before any subsequent push on that branch.

code.finding: loadFolder calls folderTree.set() unconditionally, clobbering fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot — the root of PR #498's regression. Fix: guard with sequenceNumber comparison before set().
ensureFolderLoaded short-circuit — must be preserved when adding the sequenceNumber guard to avoid re-regressing #498.
DFS child-check in ensureFolderLoaded — must also be preserved.

loadBin auto-repair blind-publishes an empty bin (no expectedSequenceNumber) when resolveIpnsRecord returns null, including on transient 404s post-reload. API's upsertFolderIpns unconditionally increments+overwrites latestCid, wiping the real bin. Fix: bounded retry before concluding no record exists; never publish on read.

isLoading race gap: when coreKitInitialized flips true but before restoreSession sets isLoggingIn+isAuthenticated, !isLoading && !isAuthenticated is briefly true. BinPage (mounted on click, not on initial load) hits this window and bounces /bin → / → /files. Fix: include coreKitInitialized && coreKitLoggedIn && !isAuthenticated in the isLoading expression to keep loading true through the restore window.
Session restore effect — the window between coreKitInitialized flipping and this effect running is the gap that causes BinPage's auth guard to fire prematurely.

Catch block calls navigate('/files') on subfolder-load failure, guarded only by latestNavTarget — this guard does NOT update when the user navigates via sidebar (e.g. to /bin), so a stale subfolder resolve can still fire the redirect. The nav-guard fix (latestPathname ref) was applied but did NOT fix the actual bounce; the real cause was the useAuth.ts race.
IPNS resolve throttle limits are NODE_ENV-gated — relaxed in test mode. Local e2e with NODE_ENV=development causes 429 storms during post-restore root-render (step 8 timeout).
migrationsRun:true, synchronize:false — migrations auto-run on API boot, no manual step needed.
Existing folder:updated event model — REQ-3's new sharedFolder:updated event should mirror this shape exactly.

Auth guard navigate('/') fires when !isLoading && !isAuthenticated — identical to FilesPage but BinPage mounts on click (later) vs FilesPage mounting during initial load, making it uniquely vulnerable to the isLoading race gap.

workflow: Playwright trace artifacts (not just CI logs) are the correct first debugging tool for e2e failures — browser console and network are captured there; CI logs do not capture browser console output.

Downloading and extracting the Playwright report artifact from a failed CI run gives the page ARIA snapshot and console logs at the exact failure moment, which is orders of magnitude more useful than log grepping.

For iterative e2e debugging, local reproduction under the correct NODE_ENV (test, not development) is dramatically faster than CI cycles — avoid hypothesis-driven CI dispatches before confirming root cause locally.

1Password SSH signing can wedge during unattended multi-commit runs (stream issues); have a contingency to disable per-repo signing (git config commit.gpgsign false) and flag unsigned commits for later rebase-resign.

Stream idle timeout can kill long-running subagents (~72min) mid-task, leaving staged-but-uncommitted changes that the agent's still-running process then commits asynchronously — always inspect HEAD and working tree before re-applying changes after an agent timeout.

The GSD capture workflow's AskUserQuestion for grouping todos surfaces relationship types that matter: 'do together' (same branch, sequential) vs 'supersedes' (cross-link and decide separately on the superseded item's own merits).

For regression root-causing: three failed CI dispatches with converging-but-wrong hypotheses signal the need for ground-truth tooling (trace artifacts, local repro) rather than more hypothesis cycles.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged mid-unattended-run (stream 'failed to fill whole buffer'), forcing all subsequent commits to be unsigned — requires rebase-resign or admin-merge before landing.

The bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts spec uses real Web3Auth DEVNET authentication (~60-90s per login attempt) making local iteration slow, with ~50% login-flake rate from DEVNET instability.

Port 3000 conflict with IRL Network project required user authorization to kill before local stack could start.
CI logs don't capture browser console output, making the first three failure diagnoses based on incomplete information.
